comment: Assignment groups. Membership is calculated from config/identity/users.json so that the
tier a person sits in is the only thing anyone has to edit when a child gets older.

dynamic membership, keyed on each device's Windows Autopilot Group Tag - see
plan/apply engine still never manages their membership directly (memberType: device groups

groups.description: 14-17. Security baseline plus light content controls; apps are blocklisted, not allowlisted.
13 and under. Strictest tier: approved apps only, forced web filtering, tight device controls.

Device group corresponding to the adult tier. Dynamic membership rule (managed outside this repo's plan/apply engine): devices Autopilot-registered with Group Tag 'CaC-Adult' are added by Entra ID automatically. See docs/age-tiers.md.

Device group corresponding to the teen tier. Dynamic membership rule (managed outside this repo's plan/apply engine): devices Autopilot-registered with Group Tag 'CaC-Teen' are added by Entra ID automatically. See docs/age-tiers.md.

Device group corresponding to the child tier. Dynamic membership rule (managed outside this repo's plan/apply engine): Windows devices Autopilot-registered with Group Tag 'CaC-Child' are added by Entra ID automatically. Android child devices are still added manually (see docs/age-tiers.md); Group Tag dynamic rules are a Windows Autopilot-only mechanism.
Dedicated administrative accounts. Hardened, no productivity workloads.
Every human productivity account. Target for tier-independent security baselines.
Assigned device group populated by Windows Autopilot device preparation for child devices.
Assigned device group populated by Windows Autopilot device preparation for adult devices.
Assigned device group populated by Windows Autopilot device preparation for teen devices.

Whole-family group (adults and kids). Adopted from a pre-existing live group; only ever used for opt-in 'available' app assignments, never required/enforced policies, to avoid impacting the adult accounts.
Firecall accounts. Exclusion target only - never assign a policy to this group.
